properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 resolved in yarn.lock — a real (transitive) dependency of this workspace shipping the SHA-1/SHA-2 family, pulled by the legacy ethereumjs-era stack. Dependency-inventory record: what the build ships, not a specific first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@^4.2.0 is declared directly by hdwallet-gridplus (hdwallet-native and hdwallet-keepkey pin ^4.0.0); crypto-js bundles MD5 in its API surface, so MD5 ships with those adapter builds. Algorithm-level record of a declared dependency's capability; the package-level entry is the crypto-js LIB object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live WebCrypto AES-128-CTR decrypt in the native-vault keystore reader (keystore-v3/web3 secret-storage JSON, thorchain blake256 MAC variant): PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 derives the key, subtle.decrypt runs AES-CTR with the stored IV, and integrity comes from a separate Blake2b-256 MAC over key||ciphertext. Malleability is mitigated by that MAC; the mode is pinned by interop with the on-disk keystore format, though the code is changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves (^1.4.0 in hdwallet-native's manifest) is the direct dependency supplying secp256k1 ECDSA/ECDH for Bitcoin/Ethereum key derivation. Dependency-inventory entry; first-party call sites are covered by the separate secp256k1 code-scan object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 machinery resolved in the dependency tree via @noble/curves' X25519 module — records that the build ships an X25519 key-agreement implementation; no first-party call site found in the workspace.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA (over secp256k1/P-256) resolved in yarn.lock via @noble/curves and elliptic; dependency-inventory record of what the tree ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) ships via the @noble/curves dependency declared in hdwallet-native's manifest — the NIST curve is part of the dependency surface, quantum-vulnerable like the rest of the EC inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party HKDF (RFC 5869): the native-vault derives vault key material with crypto.subtle HKDF importKey/deriveBits (rawVault.ts:58,104,130, same construction exercised in deterministicGetRandomValues.test.ts), and hdwallet-native's CryptoHelper.hkdfExpand stretches a master key into separate 'enc' and 'mac' keys (CryptoHelper.ts:96,140,141). This is the key-derivation layer of the vault crypto.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak resolved in yarn.lock via @noble/hashes and the keccak/ethereumjs stack; the vault keystore notes the EVM keccak256 MAC path is currently unsupported in first-party code. Dependency-inventory record.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD resolved in yarn.lock via tweetnacl/libsodium-wrappers (nacl secretbox). Dependency-inventory record; no first-party call site found in the workspace.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 resolved in yarn.lock via @noble/ciphers (chacha20poly1305 module). Dependency-inventory record of the shipped AEAD.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XChaCha20-Poly1305 resolved in yarn.lock via @noble/ciphers. Dependency-inventory record; the vault package's encrypted storage uses this AEAD family.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js is a declared direct dependency of hdwallet-gridplus (^4.2.0), hdwallet-native (^4.0.0) and hdwallet-keepkey (^4.0.0) — the legacy crypto stack of the older adapters. It ships MD5/SHA-1/SHA-2/AES-CBC/PBKDF2/ECDH; this records what the build ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves ^1.4.0 is hdwallet-native's direct crypto dependency (secp256k1, P-256, X25519, Ed25519) — the modern, audited replacement for crypto-js in this codebase. Both the root workspace and the native package reference it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509/PKI capability rides in the resolved dependency tree: node-forge@^1.3.1 is the pure-JS X.509 toolkit resolved in yarn.lock (transitive). No first-party certificate handling found in the workspace — this records the dependency surface only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hdwallet-native-vault declares jose ^4.3.5 — the JOSE (JWS/JWE/JWK) toolkit backing the vault's encrypted-key/remote-storage layer. Algorithm-scope record of the declared dependency; the package-level entry is the jose LIB object.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
